algorithm: Round cumulative 70% and 85% sample counts; shuffle sorted building IDs with seed 42, stable-sort largest first, then assign each building to the split with the largest remaining quota (ties: train, validation, test).

difficulty.definition: Hard if whole-image sensor-vs-GT AbsRel > 0.03 on finite depths > 1e-6 m in both arrays (official eval.py validity). Remaining IDs are Easy.
